ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Правда» (pravda, 'truth') is 'truth' throughout the opening and closing thoughts, while «неправда» (nepravda, 'untruth, wrong') in the Henry George passage is 'wrong'; «бог есть отец» (bog est' otets, 'God is the father') keeps the lowercase 'father' of the source. Attributions follow the print: «По Сенеке» (po Seneke, 'After Seneca'), «По Генри Джорджу» (po Genri Dzhordzhu, 'After Henry George'), «Иоанн Златоуст» ('John Chrysostom'), and «Джон Рёскин» ('John Ruskin', with first name as printed).
